facts.text: The owner (applicant, acting through an agent) and Tasman District Council (authority); the authority refused an exemption under Schedule 1(k) for a proposed greenhouse at 2075 Motueka Valley Highway, Motueka.

Building work to erect the greenhouse includes new footings for the steel-frame posts and discharge of roof rainwater to a holding tank; figures 1 and 2 show a floor plan and north and south elevations.
The greenhouse protects vegetables grown in cultivated ground, produce is sold at the farm gate, and the greenhouse is occupied intermittently by very few people.

The 17 June 2013 application described an importance level 1 greenhouse in a rural lot under Schedule 1(k); the applicant also wrote to the authority on 19 August 2013 about handling of the application.
